Evidence · Records

Ten boundaries. Three questions each. That is the turnover package.

Was it tested? Against what acceptance criteria? Where is the record? Below is the minimum we hand over for a liquid-cooled deployment, boundary by boundary. A package should answer all three for all ten.

Definition

The turnover package (turnover package · 交付资料包) is the set of records handed over with a liquid-cooling system at commissioning. In its minimum form it answers three questions for each of the ten leak points, thirty answers in all: was the boundary tested, against what acceptance criterion, and where is the record. It also carries the metering boundary drawing, fluid chemistry at fill, flow balance per branch and the CDU approach at a stated load.

Swipe sideways to see all columns.

#BoundaryWas it tested?Against what?Where is the record?

At the server		Factory pressure / helium test per plateManufacturer spec, traceable to serialSupplier FAT certificate, indexed by rack position
02Quick disconnects
At the server		Leak test after every mate/de-mate during installZero visible weep at test pressure, held time statedConnection log: date, technician, QD serial, result
03Hose crimps
At the server		Crimp dimensional check, sample pull testAssembler process spec: crimp diameter, concentricityBatch record with crimp-tool calibration
04Manifold branches
In the rack		Manifold pressure test as an assemblyRated pressure × factor, hold time, decay limitRack integrator test sheet
05Elastomeric seals
In the rack		Material certification, fluid compatibility statementNamed elastomer grade vs named fluid, temperature rangeMaterial cert file, cross-referenced to BOM
06Threaded, compression and adapter fittings
In the rack		Torque verification, thread sealant recordTorque table by size and materialFitting log with torque wrench calibration
07Internal boundaries
In the CDU		CDU FAT: pump seal, HX gasket, filter housingManufacturer FAT protocolCDU FAT report with serial
08Field welds and hot work
Between the CDU and the facility		Weld inspection, flush, passivation, sampleWeld procedure spec; cleanliness class; passivation confirmationWeld map, flush log, lab sample result
09Balancing and isolation valves
Between the CDU and the facility		Stem and body leak check under operating pressureZero weep, valve position recordedValve schedule with as-left positions
10Fill, drain, vent and sample ports
Between the CDU and the facility		Cap and plug verification after every useAll ports capped, valves closed, taggedPort log; last-disturbed date per port

Indicative structure. Test pressures, hold times and cleanliness classes are set per project in the acceptance criteria and are not published here.

Beyond the joints: the system-level records

The ten-boundary table covers leak risk. A complete package also carries the records that make the system's performance defensible later:

  • IT power and facility power, metered separately, with the metering boundary drawn
  • Supply and return temperature with calibrated flow on each loop boundary
  • CDU approach at rated load, with the fouling allowance stated
  • Make-up and blowdown as separate water streams where evaporative rejection is used
  • Local dry-bulb and wet-bulb, from a station you can name
  • Delivered heat, where reuse exists: flow, supply and return, contract-grade meter
  • Equipment staging, bypass position and maintenance windows, as an event log
  • Tested compute-and-liquid isolation sequence, with the test date

None of that is expensive at design time. All of it is close to impossible to reconstruct afterwards.

Questions this page answers

What should a liquid-cooling turnover package contain?

For each of the ten leak points: the test that was done, the acceptance criterion it was judged against, and where the record lives. Plus the single-line diagram with the metering boundary signed, fluid chemistry at fill, flow balance per branch, the CDU approach at a stated load, and the connection log closed out for every disturbance since fill. Self-check your package

How is a turnover package scored?

Three questions for each of ten boundaries gives a maximum of 30 points. Count only what could be handed to an auditor today, not what is believed to have been done. A boundary that was tested but has no retrievable record scores one, not three. Turnover self-check tool

What if a boundary was tested but the record is missing?

Treat it as untested for acceptance purposes and re-test before handover if the boundary can still be isolated; if it cannot, record the gap explicitly in the package so the operator's service-life clock starts from a known state rather than an assumed one. How the acceptance criteria are written
